name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-battle-against-ludwig
title: Super Mario World - Battle Against Ludwig
description:
With this, you can make your SMW-like castle levels nicer looking! All of the original Ludwig Battle background, now in layer 3.
Credit is not necessary, but I'd like it :)
Released in C3 Winter 2016.

mod note: as the original status bar will cut fullscreen layer 3 backgrounds off, you may want to use a status bar patch (e.g. Sprite Status Bar)
